scguardgolem.manual.title: Security Guard Golem
scguardgolem.manual.help:
Convert a vanilla Iron Golem into an owned guard by right-clicking it with any SecurityCraft Keycard. The keycard is consumed and you become the owner.

Right-click your golem with SecurityCraft Wire Cutters to open its config screen: install modules (Harming, Speed, Smart, Storage) and SecurityCraft Allowlist/Denylist modules, toggle patrol and threat mode, and lay out a patrol route.

While holding Wire Cutters, crouch twice within 1.5 seconds to drop a route waypoint at your feet. Right-click a Bell within 64 blocks to recall your golems to their first waypoint.

Bare-hand right-click opens the passcode-protected loot; crouch + bare-hand as the owner to set the passcode. An EMP shuts the golem down — use the addon's EMP Gun (or any mod's EMP) — just like SecurityCraft's own devices; reactivate a shut-down golem by right-clicking it with redstone.
scguardgolem.manual.overview.title: Guard Golem: Overview
scguardgolem.manual.overview.help: The Security Guard Golem is an owned SecurityCraft sentry built on the vanilla Iron Golem. Give a golem an owner with a Keycard, then configure it with Wire Cutters: install modules, lay out patrol routes, lock its loot behind a passcode, and shut it down with an EMP. The following pages cover each part.
scguardgolem.manual.convert.title: Guard Golem: Converting a Golem
scguardgolem.manual.convert.help: Right-click any vanilla Iron Golem with a SecurityCraft Keycard. The keycard is consumed and you become the golem's owner, marked with a burst of sparks. Owned golems keep their health and defend you and your SecurityCraft team. Only the owner (or a server operator) can reconfigure a golem.
scguardgolem.manual.config.title: Guard Golem: Config & Modules
scguardgolem.manual.config.help: Right-click your golem with SecurityCraft Wire Cutters to open its configuration screen. Install SecurityCraft modules to upgrade it: Harming, Speed, Smart, and Storage, plus Allowlist and Denylist modules. Modules do not stack — each is simply on or off. The screen also toggles patrol and threat mode.
scguardgolem.manual.allowdeny.title: Guard Golem: Allow / Deny
scguardgolem.manual.allowdeny.help: Place a SecurityCraft Allowlist or Denylist module in the golem's config screen to control who it treats as a threat. Owners and allowed players are never attacked; denied players always are. When a threat is first spotted the golem raises an alert. Hostile mobs are targeted according to the golem's threat mode.
scguardgolem.manual.loot.title: Guard Golem: Loot Storage
scguardgolem.manual.loot.help: A golem with a Storage module collects nearby dropped items. Right-click the golem bare-handed to open its storage. Crouch + bare-hand as the owner to set a passcode; after that the loot is locked and prompts for the code — salted, hashed, and Codebreaker-resistant like other SecurityCraft locks.
scguardgolem.manual.patrol.title: Guard Golem: Patrols & Recall
scguardgolem.manual.patrol.help: While holding Wire Cutters, crouch twice within 1.5 seconds to drop a patrol waypoint at your feet. The golem walks its route between waypoints, and you can preview the path as glowing markers. In the Route tab set a Dwell time to pause at each waypoint, and a Wander radius to let the golem roam a few blocks around each stop instead of standing still. Right-click a Bell within 64 blocks to recall all of your golems to their first waypoint; they resume their patrol from there.
scguardgolem.manual.empgun.title: Guard Golem: The EMP Gun
scguardgolem.manual.empgun.help: The EMP Gun fires a pulse that shuts down any SecurityCraft device or guard it hits, leaving it inert in a puff of smoke and sparks. Crouch with redstone in hand to charge the gun into its stronger form. Reactivate a shut-down golem by right-clicking it with redstone. SecurityCraft ships no EMP of its own — this is the addon's.
scguardgolem.manual.taming.title: Guard Golem: Taming Mobs
scguardgolem.manual.taming.help: Right-click a hostile mob (not a creeper or a boss) with a Keycard to tame it into an owned Tamed Guard. Tamed guards fight for you, accept modules, and can be EMP'd and passcode-locked just like the golem. They keep the look of the mob they were made from.
